completion_policy.prototype: Instrumented bounded implementation or experiment with explicit limitations; not a completion claim.
completion_policy.complete: Acceptance evidence, comparative material coverage, conservation/work checks, refinement checks, and relevant scale/customer checks are recorded.

goals.title: Live cell-derived object skins
goals.objective: Ship blocky v1 surfaces from accepted live matter, including partial cracks and fragment skins, while preserving physics; qualify smooth/deforming refinements separately.

prototype_gate: blocky exposed-face skin follows live connectivity
partial cracks and repeated fracture update local patches
fragment state and lineage are preserved
no reskin reset or fabricated impulse
stale topology jobs reject
complete_gate: glass/oak/iron and tissue/layered cases are measured
cavity and exposed-interior behavior is verified
visual detail leaves trajectories and ledgers unchanged
surface p95/p99, memory/upload, fallback, and mesh backlog are reported
smooth/deforming work has separate convergence evidence

goals.next_action: Add bounded local mesh patches, material coordinates/layers and measured skin/contact error.
goals.evidence_status: Blocky topology, partial-cut lips, live skins, geometry export and physics-isolation tests passed. Full surface gate remains open.

goals.title: Converged material/contact response and cutting
goals.objective: Converge glass, oak, iron, and soft-tissue contact/material response and cutting under force, work, time, and space gates without strength hacks.

prototype_gate: declared laws run for glass/oak/iron/soft tissue
reactions, work, damage, and history are observable
cutting changes accepted topology without prescribed launches
axial/network path remains experimental
complete_gate: time/iteration/space/contact refinement bounds force, work, area, topology, momentum, angular momentum, and energy residuals
oak has directional evidence
iron has calibrated plastic evidence
soft tissue has finite-strain/cohesive cut evidence
asymmetric/support/third-body cases pass

goals.next_action: Use these fixtures to bound contact reactions, work and topology under time/iteration/space refinement; resolve stiff-glass stress transmission and knife separation without strength hacks.
goals.evidence_status: API-generated glass/oak/iron panels and knife/tomato repeat, but halving dt changes fracture counts; realistic fracture/cutting gate fails. Analytical rigid controls pass.

goals.title: Conservative thermal frontier
goals.objective: Add cross-region flux, cold-neighbor/frontier activation, and conservative accumulation while preserving phase, reaction, latent heat, and lag accounting.

prototype_gate: cross-region interface flux is equal and opposite
frontier activation reports cause and error bound
cold storage remains compact until wake
phase identity and latent energy remain explicit
lag/frontier age/residual are reported
complete_gate: timestep/space refinement closes heat, enthalpy, latent, fuel/oxygen, and interface residuals
activation/demotion are transactional
thermal-mechanical coupling is separately validated
law envelope limits fire/weakening claims

goals.next_action: Add cold-neighbor activation and bounded boundary/frontier error accounting without resetting accepted state.
goals.evidence_status: Explicit conservative same-clock region joining and history/phase preservation tests passed. Frontier gate remains open.

goals.title: Unified state/energy and bounded authoring API
goals.objective: Unify mechanical and thermal state in a versioned, unit-bearing runtime language with explicit stores and bounded creator/job APIs.

prototype_gate: SI/version/capability/budget validation works
named energy stores and explicit transfers are exposed
bounded jobs report admission/progress/lag/cancellation/rejection
LLM authors declarations but never ticks physics
complete_gate: promotion/demotion/contact/fracture/plasticity/reaction/phase/work/snapshot preserve ledgers
no double counting or silent work reclassification
commands are durable and capability checked
creator integration is exercised

goals.next_action: Consolidate mechanical and thermal ledgers into one versioned transition schema and exercise accepted/rejected bounded package flows.

goals.title: Measured world-load performance
goals.objective: Optimize measured active-world kernels and sparse-active scheduling without changing laws; keep cold storage out of full simulation.

prototype_gate: storage and allocator overhead are separated
p50/p95/p99, backlog, age, residual, lag, and memory are reported
fixed and growing active-count matrices exist
only measured kernels are optimized
cold storage is not fully simulated
complete_gate: declared scale/load matrices meet budgets or report bounded backlog
approximately 1M and 16M stored-voxel cases are measured with fixed active count
active-count growth and wake churn are measured when available
CPU-reference outputs and residuals remain within declared tolerances
no world-scale realtime claim comes from a small fixture

goals.next_action: Add explicit contact-demand admission/runtime budgets, investigate speculative-contact scale, and measure active contact/cell load growth before increasing scale.
goals.evidence_status: Small native scenes complete at 1x with active-frame p95 about 17 ms; generated 537-cell scene exceeds contact constraints on first update. No world-scale realtime claim.

goals.title: Snapshot, publishing, and customer conformance
goals.objective: Make accepted worlds and objects recoverable, publishable, compatible, and testable through the ax/tree, door/panel, and tomato-bowl loop.

prototype_gate: snapshots include authoritative state/history/energy/config fingerprints
publication is crash-atomic and dependency validated
incompatible versions reject
customer fixtures report unsupported behavior explicitly
complete_gate: save/recover/replay/publish/import/rollback preserve accepted state
manifests support validation/preview/permissions/migration
authority/bandwidth/determinism behavior is measured
ax/tree, door/panel, and tomato bowl pass customer conformance

goals.next_action: Define snapshot manifest and compatibility matrix; run crash/restart, migration rejection, publish/import, and customer-loop fixtures.

dependency_policy: Dependencies name shared contracts and final acceptance gates; independent prototype slices may proceed in parallel. An active dependent goal does not certify its prerequisite complete.
